ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the sector $ABC$ with a radius of 6, $\angle AOB=120^\circ$, C is a moving point on the arc $\overset{\frown}{AB}$ (not coinciding with A or B), $OD\perp AC$, $OE\perp BC$, with the feet of the perpendiculars being points D and E, respectively. What is the length of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, connect $AB$, and draw $OF\perp AB$ at $F$,\\
$\because \angle AOB=120^\circ, OA=OB$,\\
$\therefore \angle OAB=\angle OBA=\frac{180^\circ-\angle AOB}{2}=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OF=\frac{1}{2}OA=3$,\\
In $\triangle AOF$, by the Pythagorean theorem, $AF=\sqrt{OA^{2}-OF^{2}}=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$, by the perpendicular diameter theorem, $AB=2AF=6\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\because OD\perp AC, OE\perp BC$,\\
$\therefore$ D and E are respectively the midpoints of $AC$ and $BC$,\\
$\therefore DE$ is the midline of $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore DE=\frac{1}{2}AB=3\sqrt{3}$;\\
Thus, the length of $DE$ is $\boxed{3\sqrt{3}}$.

再推理：按题意半径为 6，∠AOB=120°。建立坐标系，以 O 为原点，取 A=(-3√3,3)，B=(3√3,3)。这两点到原点的距离都是 sqrt(27+9)=6，且它们对应的圆心角为 120°。设弧上的动点 C=(6cos t,6sin t)。对于圆心在原点的圆上任意弦 PQ，P、Q 到原点距离相等，弦 PQ 的中点 M=(P+Q)/2 满足 M·(Q-P)=(|Q|^2-|P|^2)/2=0，所以 OM⊥PQ，即圆心到弦的垂足就是弦的中点。因此 D 是 AC 的中点，E 是 BC 的中点，所以 D=(A+C)/2，E=(B+C)/2。于是向量 DE=E-D=(B-A)/2，与 C 的位置无关。计算 AB=|(3√3,3)-(-3√3,3)|=|(6√3,0)|=6√3，因此 DE=AB/2=3√3。

What is the length of $DE$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, connect $AB$, and draw $OF\perp AB$ at $F$,\\
$\because \angle AOB=120^\circ, OA=OB$,\\
$\therefore \angle OAB=\angle OBA=\frac{180^\circ-\angle AOB}{2}=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OF=\frac{1}{2}OA=3$,\\
In $\triangle AOF$, by the Pythagorean theorem, $AF=\sqrt{OA^{2}-OF^{2}}=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$, by the perpendicular diameter theorem, $AB=2AF=6\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\because OD\perp AC, OE\perp BC$,\\
$\therefore$ D and E are respectively the midpoints of $AC$ and $BC$,\\
$\therefore DE$ is the midline of $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore DE=\frac{1}{2}AB=3\sqrt{3}$;\\
Thus, the length of $DE$ is $\boxed{3\sqrt{3}}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The attached diagram shows a circular sector with center O and endpoints A and B on the arc. Point C is also on the arc between A and B. Segments AC and BC are drawn as chords. Segment OD is drawn from O to a point D on AC, and segment OE is drawn from O to a point E on BC. The diagram labels A, B, C, D, E, and O consistently with the problem statement.

Reasoning: From the problem text, the circle/sector radius is 6, so OA = OB = OC = 6, and the central angle ∠AOB is 120°. Since OD is perpendicular to chord AC and O is the center, the perpendicular from the center to chord AC bisects that chord; hence D is the midpoint of AC. Similarly, OE is perpendicular to chord BC, so E is the midpoint of BC. In triangle ABC, the segment joining the midpoints of AC and BC is a midline, so DE = AB/2. Now AB is the chord subtending central angle 120° in a circle of radius 6, so AB = 2R sin(120°/2) = 12 sin 60° = 12 · √3/2 = 6√3. Therefore DE = AB/2 = 3√3.
